scope: Public API metadata staging gate with a synthetic dependent integer Metal workload; no LLM timing claim.

measurement.boundaries: After synchronized step1 metadata setup, time first workload enqueue, then stage2 population/upload plus observer enqueue, then final DeviceContext.synchronize. Numerical verification is outside timing.
measurement.order: map then pinned in even pairs, pinned then map in odd pairs
measurement.source_lifetime: Distinct first and second HostBuffers preallocated; idle second stage populated after step1 enqueue; both sources held through final synchronization. Same device metadata buffer reused by operations ordered on one context.

validation.step1_late_read_contract: Each row reads first-record metadata after its dependent integer recurrence, at an address derived from its recurrence result; every late read must still equal17+index.

gates.host_submit_next_metadata_while_work_out: pass for distinct immutable pinned stages with same-context ordered copy
